free_text: The decision leans toward biopsy because the statistical prior suggested it, and the retrieved evidence showed a high-risk PI-RADS 5 lesion and a rising PSA trend from 3.1 ng/mL to 9.3 ng/mL. Although the prior positive biopsy status exists, the absence of a documented prior grade or comparison against a previous MRI means the retrieved findings necessitate further tissue characterization to guide definitive management.
